How do I get around the paywall on news sites like the NYT or WSJ?

Here are the methods that actually work, roughly in order of usefulness:

**Archive sites**
- **archive.today** (archive.ph): paste the article URL. If anyone's snapshotted it, you get the full text, no paywall. Works on a huge share of popular NYT/WSJ pieces.
- **Wayback Machine** for older articles.

**Browser tricks**
- **Incognito/private mode** resets metered paywalls (they count your free articles via cookies). NYT is hard-metered in the US but still gives free monthly articles in many other countries — a VPN + incognito can reset that meter.
- **Reader mode** (Firefox/Safari): some sites load the full text into the page and just hide it with JavaScript. Reader view grabs the hidden text. On some sites you can also stop the page load right as the article text flashes by.
- **Clear cookies/site data** for the same reset effect without a private window.

**Extensions**
- **Bypass Paywalls Clean** — the standard tool; handles WSJ, NYT, and hundreds of other sites. It was pulled from the Chrome Web Store, so get it from GitHub (the Firefox version installs normally; for Chrome you load it as an unpacked extension).

**Free routes**
- **Library card**: many public libraries give cardholders free remote access to WSJ.com and NYT (NYT runs a library-access program where you redeem access codes). This is probably the single best free option.
- **Google One perks**: Google One has bundled a free WSJ subscription for US members — check the perks page.
- **Gift links**: NYT and WSJ subscribers can generate free "gift" URLs for individual articles — ask a friend or coworker.
- **Cheap trials**: both run near-constant promos ($1–4/month for a year), and WSJ has steep student discounts if that applies to you.

**Per-site notes**
- **WSJ**: MSN republishes a lot of WSJ content free — search `site:msn.com` plus the headline. The old Google-click-through trick (paste the headline into Google, click the result) also still works on some articles.
- **NYT**: archive.today plus the VPN meter-reset are your best bets; gift links are common since lots of people have subscriptions.

The combo of archive.ph + Bypass Paywalls + a library card covers almost everything.
